item.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption provides tools for public agencies to reduce fraud in job applications.
item.support: This report provides a range of techniques and tools that agencies can apply to address employment application fraud.

item.text: It examines screening frameworks, responsibility for checks, checking methods and the screening of temporary workers.
item.support: assigning roles and responsibilities for employment screening, improving the quality of employment screening checks and screening non-permanent workers.

item.text: The Commission reports that inadequate screening contributed to corruption exposed in several of its investigations.
item.support: corrupt conduct in the NSW public sector that was brought about, or in some way attributable to, inadequate employment screening practices.

item.text: The Commission recommends screening tailored to each role’s risks and comparable checks for permanent and non-permanent workers.
item.support: Non-permanent workers should be subject to employment screening checks in the same way as those undertaken on permanent employees.

item.quote: This report recommends that agencies adopt a risk-based approach for preventing employment application fraud and ensure that any screening checks are standardised and justifiable.
